metadata.description: ComStock-owned building type definitions used by the create_custom_building_from_spec measure. Space type ratios and building form defaults in all_level_space_types vocabulary, so no prototype space type mapping is needed at runtime.
notes: building_subtype "NA" means the entry applies to any subtype.
applicable_templates lists every template the entry covers, ASHRAE and DEER together.
DEER templates reuse the ASHRAE ratios for their era: vintages before 2004 join the DOE Ref entry, 2004 and later join the 90.1 entry.
construction_defaults carries the envelope every building type shares under a template; a building type entry carries only what differs from it. Merge the two, default first, one level into slots.

A merged construction spec names every surface, so it does not need a row in the standards construction_sets table. That table is keyed on the building types of the template family and holds no ASHRAE name under a DEER template.
